testTitle: HSSC CET Group C - Mock Test 1

questions.q_en: In which year was the state of Haryana formed?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा राज्य का गठन किस वर्ष किया गया था?
questions.explanation: Haryana was formed on 1st November 1966 after being separated from Punjab.

questions.q_en: Which city is known as the 'Science City' of Haryana?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा के किस शहर को 'विज्ञान नगरी' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: Ambala is called the Science City because it is a major hub for scientific instruments.

questions.q_en: Who is the first Prime Minister of India?
questions.q_hi: भारत के पहले प्रधानमंत्री कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru was the first Prime Minister of independent India.

questions.q_en: Which is the largest district of Haryana by area?
questions.q_hi: क्षेत्रफल की दृष्टि से हरियाणा का सबसे बड़ा जिला कौन सा है?
questions.explanation: Sirsa is currently the largest district of Haryana by area.

questions.q_en: Which planet is known as the 'Red Planet'?
questions.q_hi: किस ग्रह को 'लाल ग्रह' के रूप में जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: Mars is known as the Red Planet due to iron oxide on its surface.

questions.q_en: Where is the headquarters of Haryana Police?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा पुलिस का मुख्यालय कहाँ स्थित है?
questions.explanation: The headquarters of Haryana Police is located in Sector 6, Panchkula.

questions.q_en: What is the capital of France?
questions.explanation: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.

questions.q_en: Which city is known as the 'City of Weavers' in Haryana?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा के किस शहर को 'बुनकरों का शहर' कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Panipat is known as the 'City of Weavers' for its famous handloom products.

questions.q_en: Who wrote the national anthem of India?
questions.q_hi: भारत का राष्ट्रगान किसने लिखा था?
questions.explanation: Jana Gana Mana was composed by Rabindranath Tagore.

questions.q_en: What is the state bird of Haryana?
questions.q_hi: हरियाणा का राजकीय पक्षी क्या है?
questions.explanation: The Black Francolin is the official state bird of Haryana.
